digest.component_or_area: LLM review kernel and consumer pipelines
propositions: verify_findings() generates per-chunk outcome_counts (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) and contract_violations but neither consumer pipeline can invoke it due to declarative workflow architecture; per-chunk boundaries are lost after merge

plan_review_decide records contract violations via a ContextVar sink (collect_contract_violations/record_contract_violation/drain_contract_violations in orchestrator.py) but code_review_decide only logs errors, leaving code-review contract violation data unpropagated to verdict coverage

A shared contract-violation sink must be extracted from plan_review/orchestrator.py into review_kernel and wired into code-review's gate_dispatch._run_code_review_gate and code_review_decide to achieve parity

A shared decide_outcome_counts() helper in review_kernel must compute whole-run outcome tallies from merged *_decide boundary data (empty_outcomes from empty raw_verifs, recovered from reshape.has_violations, clean otherwise, unrecoverable always 0 per workflow engine retry layer)
Both plan_review_decide and code_review_decide must call the shared helper and emit outcome_counts in their output dicts for propagation to verdict coverage as an additive observability key
